back: **LCNRV**: FIFO, average, all others. **LCM** (with ceiling/floor): **LIFO** and the **retail** inventory method.
Market = replacement cost, limited by **ceiling = NRV** and **floor = NRV − normal profit**. Pick the **middle** value.

front: Can inventory write-downs be reversed (U.S. GAAP)?
back: **No** for annual periods — the written-down amount is the new cost. (Interim recoveries within the year are allowed; IFRS allows reversals.)

front: Markup on cost → gross profit % on sales
back: GP% = markup ÷ (1 + markup). 25% on cost = **20%** on sales; 50% on cost = 33⅓%.
Conventional **excludes** net markdowns from the cost-to-retail ratio (lower ratio ≈ LCM); average includes them.
Year 1 income **overstated**; Year 2 income **understated**; retained earnings correct after Year 2.
